scheme_name: Hinglaj Devi Temple and Nankana Sahib Yatra in Pakistan- Madhya Pradesh
other_conditions: The applicant must have completed the pilgrimage to Hinglaj Devi Temple and Nankana Sahib in Pakistan.
The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.
Each individual is eligible for the grant only once in their lifetime.
benefits_summary: State Government reimburses 50% of pilgrimage expenses up to ₹30,000 per pilgrim.
documents_required: Certificate of actual expenses incurred after the journey
